messages:
Priya N: Quick ask  need a 2-sentence internal RN + pin for a tiny perf tweak planned tomorrow. Can someone make it snappy and add the rollback command?
Evan B: drop the draft here and I'll tighten. aim for one line for the channel pin.
Priya N: Draft: 
```
Tiny rollout: adjust scheduler buffer to reduce request queuing spikes (improves p99 latency by ~15%). Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. Rollback tag: release-2026-03-15-buffix.
```
Kai L: Suggest replace 'adjust scheduler buffer' with 'scheduler buffer tuning (no model changes)'. also include a short PR link.
Marta S: I'll take the pin copy. How do we run rollback quick? paste exact command.
Evan B: edited one-liner for pin: "Scheduler buffer tuning (no model changes). Canary 10%	5%100% over 20m. Rollback: release-2026-03-15-buffix. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/1299"
Priya N: perfect. @DeployBot can you schedule the canary at 2026-03-15T09:00:00Z and pin the message at T-15?
DeployBot: schedule accepted. Canary steps [10%,50%,100%] at 09:00Z with 7m checks. Will pin RN in #eng-releases at 08:45Z.
Kai L: rollback runbook (quick):
```sh
# fast rollback to previous stable tag
redwood deploy --env=prod --tag=release-2026-03-15-buffix --force --reason="scheduler-buf-regression"
# confirm: redwood status --env=prod | grep release-2026-03-15-buffix
```
Marta S: Added standby roster to the pin: Priya (APAC), Kai (US-PST), Evan (US-EST). Also adding escalation: if 5xx rate >1% for 2 mins -> rollback.
Priya N: Nice. Also include a short customer-facing blurb after the launch: "Weve deployed a small improvement to request handling that may reduce latency; no action needed." Marta, can you post that once internal pin is live?
Marta S: Will do. Posting plan: internal pin at 08:45Z, canary start 09:00Z, customer blurb 30m after successful 100% step.
Evan B: One more: include the observability query we use to check errors: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (instance)`; escalate if >30rps baseline.
Priya N: Good call. Everything captured. Thanks team. @here pinned RN + rollback cmd + DeployBot schedule confirmed. Good luck :rocket:
DeployBot: RN pinned in #eng-releases by Marta S. Canary job started: waiting for manual approval at 09:00Z.
